counters.limitation: Per-prompt/device native counters only. Worker busy, copy, DMA and slot intervals overlap; never sum them into wall time or across devices. File payload/elapsed rate is not disk bandwidth; page-cache file bytes do not prove physical reads. Rounded counters do not establish predictor recall, on-time readiness, duplicate reads, wasted bytes or a performance gain.
